entities.summary: Joy Isi Bewaji is a Nigerian essayist, screenwriter, playwright, new media entrepreneur and social affairs activist. Her writings and plays have been centred on cultural inappropriateness and religious anomalies. She identifies as a feminist, and her viewpoint on public issues have caused her to be described as a "modern-day fearless feminist" by the media.
